name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one value from a list of five or more options.
a11y: Trigger is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the list is role=listbox with option items.
Arrow keys, Home, End and type-ahead move; Enter selects; Escape closes.
Inside a Field it is labelled by the Field's label.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`). A surrounding Field sets this from its `error`.
